title: Control Director Reliability and Codex-like Chat

milestones.title: Mac Studio exact-runtime baseline and dirty-checkout protection
milestones.acceptance: Every proof names the immutable source SHA and privacy-safe Mac Studio host identity and refuses a dirty, mismatched, or non-Mac-Studio source/runtime root.

milestones.title: Mac Studio user-experience SLOs and quality rubric
milestones.acceptance: Executable Mac Studio-local acceptance defines ACK, activity, cancellation, memory, layout, completion, and quality thresholds.

milestones.title: Ownership charter
milestones.acceptance: Chat, PCC, Control Director, Program Manager, Judge, SIG, System Quality, and orchestrator each have one non-overlapping owner contract.

milestones.title: Canonical Control Director identity and model registry
milestones.acceptance: Runtime scope is agent-role based, supports Gemma default and safe alternatives, and has no exact-name or stale-model bypass.

milestones.title: Typed execution event protocol
milestones.acceptance: Task, run, goal, activity, evidence, approval, Judge, and notification events are typed and versioned.

milestones.title: Canonical execution-state store
milestones.acceptance: Chat, PCC, goals, workers, and diagnostics project one authoritative durable execution state.

milestones.title: Typed intent and response-mode classification
milestones.acceptance: Chat, answer, plan, execute, status, steer, queue, and goal intents produce deterministic mode contracts.

milestones.title: Durable immediate ACK
milestones.acceptance: Accepted messages receive a persisted run identity and visible ACK within the declared SLO.

milestones.title: Always-available conversation lane
milestones.acceptance: Long-running work never prevents the user from receiving an ACK, asking a side question, or issuing control input.

milestones.title: Least-privilege delegation policy
milestones.acceptance: The Director delegates execution by default and receives only narrowly justified direct mutation capabilities.

milestones.title: Durable worker mailbox
milestones.acceptance: Assignments and results survive process restart and are idempotently correlated to the originating mission.

milestones.title: Continuous worker fan-in
milestones.acceptance: Worker state and evidence generate condensed user-visible updates without polling loops.

milestones.title: Cancellation and preemption
milestones.acceptance: Cancel, pause, and preempt are sticky, idempotent, and prevent new child work after acknowledgement.

milestones.title: Lease-driven Pursue Goal executor
milestones.acceptance: A goal marked running owns a current lease, heartbeat, controller, next action, and terminal completion delivery.

milestones.title: Pursue Goal controls
milestones.acceptance: Create, edit, pause, resume, stop, retry, and inspect controls work from Chat and survive refresh.

milestones.title: Mac Studio crash and disconnect recovery
milestones.acceptance: Mac Studio Gateway restart, local browser disconnect, and worker loss resume safely or reach an honest terminal state.

milestones.title: Bidirectional queue and steer controls
milestones.acceptance: Any pending input can switch queue to steer or steer to queue until server admission closes the mutation window.

milestones.title: Atomic multi-client turn mutation
milestones.acceptance: Revision and idempotency checks prevent duplicate, lost, or misordered queue and steer actions across clients.

milestones.title: Condensed inline activity timeline
milestones.acceptance: Chat shows acknowledged, delegated, working, waiting, blocked, verifying, and terminal activity inline and collapsibly.

milestones.title: Unobstructed Chat layout
milestones.acceptance: Transcript and composer remain primary with no static Project, PCC, goal, or diagnostic blocks between them.

milestones.title: PCC strict-boundary redesign
milestones.acceptance: PCC owns plans and evidence while execution state remains an orchestrator projection.

milestones.title: Typed Chat-to-PCC projection
milestones.acceptance: No PCC milestone or status mutation is inferred from assistant prose or regular expressions.

milestones.title: Recents, titles, rename, and pinning
milestones.acceptance: Recent sessions are immediately visible, meaningfully named, renameable, and pinnable without delaying the primary reply.

milestones.title: Responsive and accessible Mac Studio Chat
milestones.acceptance: Mac Studio-local authenticated production Chrome tests at supported Mac window sizes prove transcript, composer, controls, keyboard, and accessibility behavior.

milestones.title: Canonical execution profile
milestones.acceptance: Chat, PCC, goals, and agents resolve one versioned local/Codex model and approval policy; Codex defaults explicitly to the current quality-first model (GPT-5.6 Sol as of 2026-07-20), selects effort by bounded work class, preserves explicit user overrides, and never silently downgrades.

milestones.title: Quality-gated local-first routing
milestones.acceptance: Deterministic and local lanes handle suitable work without silently lowering evaluated output quality.

milestones.title: Governed Codex escalation adapter
milestones.acceptance: Codex escalation is explicit, scoped, budgeted, attributable, and fail-closed when unavailable.

milestones.title: Compact Codex mission packets
milestones.acceptance: Codex receives typed goals, constraints, evidence, state, and acceptance criteria instead of raw transcript bloat.

milestones.title: Model-routing evaluation matrix
milestones.acceptance: Representative tasks prove quality, latency, memory, and resource thresholds for each admitted route.

milestones.title: Resource and model-residency governor
milestones.acceptance: CPU, memory, thermal, concurrency, and model residency remain within tested Mac Studio budgets.

milestones.title: Mac Studio cold and warm latency SLOs
milestones.acceptance: Exact managed-model cold and warm trials on the Mac Studio meet ACK, activity, and substantive-response thresholds.

milestones.title: Tiered memory architecture
milestones.acceptance: Recent session/task memory is hot, project summaries are warm, and compressed older history remains searchable.

milestones.title: First-turn recent recall
milestones.acceptance: Yesterday and recent-task references are retrieved automatically with measured Top-3 recall.

milestones.title: Context budget and compaction continuity
milestones.acceptance: Long conversations compact before overflow while retaining mission, decisions, work state, approvals, and recent turns.

milestones.title: Memory privacy and rebuild
milestones.acceptance: Visibility, retention, provenance, deletion, corruption recovery, and deterministic rebuild are tested.

milestones.title: SIG responsibility contract
milestones.acceptance: SIG detects and routes recurring systemic deficiencies but cannot silently mutate or deploy production.

milestones.title: UX and reliability telemetry
milestones.acceptance: ACK, activity, goals, memory, layout, titles, queueing, delivery, and completion expose typed health signals.

milestones.title: Exact-config canary and replay
milestones.acceptance: Canaries use the deployed identity, model, prompt, tools, skills, memory, and UI rather than a mock substitute.

milestones.title: System Quality surface
milestones.acceptance: Judge, SIG, diagnostics, and canary evidence live outside the Chat transcript flow with contextual deep links.

milestones.title: Bounded self-healing
milestones.acceptance: Only allowlisted reversible repairs run automatically with rollback, evidence, and escalation on recurrence.

milestones.title: Independent Judge service
milestones.acceptance: A real independent Judge validates exact mission acceptance and evidence and emits a signed claim-bound receipt.

milestones.title: Role, prompt, skill, and tool alignment
milestones.acceptance: Workspace files, prompts, skills, tool permissions, plugins, docs, and runtime configuration express the same role contract.

milestones.title: Instruction-following torture suite
milestones.acceptance: Multi-turn, compaction, steering, delegation, blocker, and completion scenarios pass at least 98 percent with zero critical omissions.

milestones.title: Mac Studio canary, soak, rollback, and production acceptance
milestones.acceptance: Exact SHA promotion, restart, soak, rollback, Mac Studio Dashboard, and user-visible completion are verified on the managed Mac Studio.

milestones.title: Active contract wiring gate
milestones.acceptance: Every required contract, prompt, guard, and policy has an executable production caller and dead wiring fails readiness.

milestones.title: Proportional response contracts
milestones.acceptance: Ordinary conversation is not forced through project completion fields while execution claims remain evidence-gated.

milestones.title: Immutable mission envelope
milestones.acceptance: The full request, criteria, scope, approvals, provenance, artifacts, and idempotency identity survive continuation and compaction.

milestones.title: Durable workflow orchestrator
milestones.acceptance: One engine owns leases, heartbeats, retries, dependencies, fan-in, cancellation, and terminal transitions.

milestones.title: Server-owned mutable turn inbox and outbox
milestones.acceptance: Pending turns and delivery receipts are durable, revisioned, recoverable, and client-independent.

milestones.title: Single production Chat stack
milestones.acceptance: One Chat implementation owns production behavior and all acceptance tests target that implementation.

milestones.title: Execution-state reconciler
milestones.acceptance: Stale running goals, pending delivery, lost workers, and orphaned state reconcile automatically and visibly.

milestones.title: Prompt and capability budget compiler
milestones.acceptance: Only mode-relevant instructions, tools, skills, and memory enter each prompt, with deterministic token budgets.

milestones.title: Program Manager and Judge capability repair

milestones.title: Unified approval envelope

milestones.title: Memory freshness and provenance
milestones.acceptance: Current-day ingestion, recent-task indexing, conflicts, source attribution, and rollup health are measurable and repaired.

milestones.title: Mac Studio exact-runtime lineage monitoring
milestones.acceptance: Readiness proves the privacy-safe Mac Studio host identity, active immutable source, managed config, runtime process, and Dashboard build lineage with no arbitrary cwd dependence.

milestones.title: Typed SIG user-journey signals
milestones.acceptance: Silence, stalled goals, memory misses, layout obstruction, title failures, queue races, and delivery misses become typed SIG evidence.

milestones.title: SIG proof-backed closure governance
milestones.acceptance: Resolution requires typed proof, independent validation, observation windows, owner, SLA, and recurrence reopening.

milestones.title: Chaos and state-hygiene suite
milestones.acceptance: Restart, disconnect, compaction, concurrency, duplicate delivery, migration, and model-unload failures are reproducibly contained.

milestones.title: Instruction coverage and quality acceptance
milestones.acceptance: Every instruction maps to outcome, evidence, or explicit blocker; aggregate quality is at least 93 with no unresolved P0 defect.

milestones.title: Customization update-survival acceptance
milestones.acceptance: Every Dashboard, plugin, skill, workflow, and runtime customization is registered; an exact-parent simulated official update preserves the monotonic capability/path inventory, runs the manifest gate, binds approval proof, loads the prepare-only weekly broker and runtime recovery guard from the promoted release, and retains managed rollback.

milestones.title: Deterministic subagent incident reproduction baseline

milestones.title: Task-root inheritance and worktree confinement

milestones.title: Reliable worker discovery and spawn guidance
milestones.acceptance: Every orchestrator can discover only spawnable workers through an available capability, and every spawn failure recommends an action the caller can actually perform.

milestones.title: Role-capability and handoff alignment
milestones.acceptance: Control Director, Program Manager, worker, Judge, SIG, and PCC prompts, tools, roles, and handoffs express one executable least-privilege contract with no impossible assignment.

milestones.title: Mandatory skill and workflow deployment consistency
milestones.acceptance: Required skills, plugins, prompts, workflows, runtime helpers, and customization inventory entries are installed from the immutable release and verified after update and restart.

milestones.title: Evidence-bound completion and diagnostic truth
milestones.acceptance: Completion, blocker, worker, and task-root claims are derived from typed evidence and independently rejected when unsupported, stale, mismatched, or unavailable.

milestones.title: Mac Studio exact-runtime end-to-end orchestration acceptance
milestones.acceptance: The landed exact SHA passes Mac Studio-local source validation, managed activation, Control Director to Program Manager to worker to Judge flow, SIG and PCC consistency, queue, steer, cancel, Pursue Goal, memory, restart, rollback, soak, and Mac Studio Dashboard proof without a remote-execution dependency.

milestones.title: Dual progress and roadmap schema migration
milestones.acceptance: M01 through M106 expose implementation and certification state separately while status remains a validated compatibility mirror of certification state.

milestones.title: Canonical active-lineage registry

milestones.title: Lifecycle provenance and audit receipts

milestones.title: Concurrent lifecycle stress and adversarial review
